brand-card-stack.label: Brand Card Stack
brand-card-stack.description: Interactive stacked media layout with one featured asset and supporting images or videos. Scroll-driven animation spreads cards out; the featured asset can expand to full-screen. Typically used as a hero-scale brand moment on landing pages.

slots.name: cards
slots.description: 5–8 child elements (5 minimum enforced by the component, 8 recommended max). Exactly one must have `data-featured="true"` — this can be a video element (all others should be still images in that case). Others can be img or containers wrapping an img.

attrs.name: data-featured
attrs.description: Applied to ONE child element inside the cards slot (not the host) to mark it as the featured asset. Required — component will not render correctly without it.

attrs.name: data-image-expand
attrs.description: Full-screen expand is ON by default. Set to `"false"` to disable the full-screen takeover; the scroll-spread animation still plays.

image_dimensions.notes: Applies to both featured and supporting assets.

brand-card-stack.notes: Hard minimum of 5 assets (component logs a warning and renders empty if fewer). Recommended count is 5–6; supports up to 8. Video supported only as the featured element; all other slots should be still images.

brand-logo-animation.label: Brand Chevron Animation
brand-logo-animation.description: Animated UMD chevron logo scroll element. Drop-in decorative brand motion — no slots or attributes.
brand-logo-animation.notes: Pure behavior component. Typically placed between sections as a scroll transition.

brand-chevron-promo.label: Brand Chevron Promo
brand-chevron-promo.description: Promotional call-to-action band on a black background with decorative brand chevron line work. Outlined chevrons slide in from the left and drift right at varying speeds (mirroring the forward.umd.edu campaign hero), then centered content fades in and up. Dark gradients sit under the text to keep it readable over the arrows. Min height 500px desktop / 355px mobile. Headline uses the campaign typeface. Added in components 2.0.0.

slots.name: headline
slots.description: Main heading. Rendered in the campaign typeface.

slots.name: eyebrow
slots.description: Small ribbon text above the headline.

slots.name: text
slots.description: Supporting text. Follows the medium text lockup; wrap paragraphs in a <div>.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Call-to-action buttons or links. Use dark-theme CTAs — the background is black.

attrs.name: data-animation
attrs.description: Controls WHEN the chevron animation starts, not whether it runs. Default (omitted) starts it on component load. Set to "false" to defer until the section scrolls into view.

brand-chevron-promo.notes: Background is black and is supplied by the component — do NOT wrap in umd-layout-background-full-dark or set an inline dark background. Do not add a horizontal spacing class to the host; the band is full-bleed. Headline is the only required slot. CTAs in the actions slot need data-theme="dark". The 2.0.0 stylesheet ships the not-defined/FOUC guard for this tag — pages pinned to web-styles-library@1.8.16 will not have it, so the band may flash unstyled on load (see CLAUDE.md → "ACTIVE EXCEPTION — stylesheet pin lags the submodule").
